title: BC Friday Tips #38 Keep Description
summary: The Keep Description field in General Journals prevents the Description from being cleared when users change the Account Type, which is useful for preserving descriptions in imported or auto-generated journals.
key_points: By default, BC clears the Description field when Account Type is changed on a journal line
The Keep Description field preserves the description text when switching between account types
Particularly beneficial for journals that are imported or generated automatically
Allows users to maintain description integrity without manual re-entry

quotes.text: When you change the Account Type, BC clears the Description field by default.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core problem that the Keep Description field solves

quotes.text: The Keep Description field can be used to preserve your text when switching accounts.
quotes.why_it_matters: Describes the key capability and its primary use case
